annotations.title: Get short course and current schedules

description: Get a published short course by exact seoId with public provider/campus details. Includes class dates and fees when available; otherwise schedules are explicitly unavailable. Listed classes do not guarantee remaining seats. Read-only: use returned website links to apply. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.
